headline: Last session: Sensex dropped 1,484 points while markets remain closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Profit-taking dragged Indian shares down after a four-week rally.
Heavy selling was witnessed across banking and metal stocks during the last session.
Financial stocks faced notable selling pressure dragging down major benchmarks.
Broad market decline occurred despite continuous buying from foreign institutional investors.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE are closed today, November 24, on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the previous session, Sensex dropped 1,484 points while Nifty fell below 25,400.
FIIs invested ₹5,672.99 crore in the last session, extending their buying streak to 16 sessions.
GSK Pharma announced the launch of Blenrep combination therapy for multiple myeloma.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti. In the previous session, the Sensex fell 1,484 points amid heavy profit-taking in banking, financial, and metal stocks. FIIs continued their buying streak, infusing ₹5,672.99 crore despite the market decline.
